name: DocStudio MCP
description:
DocStudio brings your full document workflow into Claude. Draft and edit documents from a prompt, send them out for e-signature, and track status — all without leaving the conversation.
Ask Claude to pull up a document, redline it, generate a new one from a template, or check whether a sent envelope has been signed. DocStudio handles the document lifecycle end-to-end: creation, review, signature routing, and storage — so teams, sales reps, and individual professionals can go from draft to signed without switching tools.
Connect your DocStudio account once, and Claude can read, create, and manage documents on your behalf using secure OAuth authentication.

_published_faq.name: How do I add DocStudio MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add DocStudio MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.docstudio.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the DocStudio MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: DocStudio MCP lists 15 MCP tools, including create_envelope_from_template, fill_envelope, get_account, get_document_content, get_envelope, get_envelope_approvals, get_envelope_documents, get_envelope_shared_with, get_envelope_table_data, get_template, get_user_profile, and list_mailboxes.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to DocStudio MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to DocStudio MCP in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does DocStudio MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: DocStudio MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
DocStudio MCP is developed by Retail Content Service Inc. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
